claimsToVerify: Ancient Egyptian beer was thick, porridge-like, and often consumed through straws or strainers.
Sand and grit from grinding stones in Egyptian flour caused severe dental erosion across social classes.
Onions, dates, and salted Nile fish were common components of the ancient Egyptian diet.
Laborers in ancient Egypt were paid in bread and beer rations.
